results.title: Julia Roberts Celebrates 59: A Heartfelt Tribute from Danny Moder
results.description: Cinematographer Danny Moder shared a heartfelt tribute to Julia Roberts on her 59th birthday, celebrating their life together. The couple, who met in 2000, have built a strong family and witnessed Roberts' rise as a Hollywood icon. From her breakout roles in the late 1980s to her recent projects, Roberts continues to captivate audiences. Explore their journey and her ongoing contributions to film and television in this engaging article.
